name: langtitles
description: Browser extension (Firefox and Chrome): interlinear word-by-word subtitle breakdowns for any streaming site, powered by Claude.

scripts.package: npm run build:data && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.build:dict: echo "node scripts/build-dict.mjs JMdict_e kanjidic2.xml; node scripts/build-kodict.mjs kaikki-Korean.jsonl; node scripts/build-zhdict.mjs cedict.txt (see README)"
